GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2021-07-04T13:31:44Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: How to clear the view and the buffer?
Description: My app is focusing on downloading videos and then playing them with Exoplayer. And obviously Downloading comes together with deleting the file.

So the downloading/playing parts work but then I want to be able to clear the player when the user is deleting the video he/she is playing. So I have:

```
videoView.player?.stop()
videoView.player?.release()
```

However, the videoview still shows the image that it was last playing and I'm also guessing that the buffer is still there because when I delete and redownload the same video just after I cannot play it, it gives me this error:

